decisive_items: Step-up in oxygenation from superior vena cava (71%) and inferior vena cava (77%) to right atrium (84%)
response.rationale: The defect with left-to-right shunt and oxygen step-up at the atrial level directly indicate an atrial septal defect; RBBB is a secondary ECG finding.

rejected.why: Describes only the ECG conduction abnormality, not the underlying structural defect.
Duplicate of R1, also only reflects RBBB without addressing the shunt or defect.
